command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Manufactured wall and material rise at 1 K/s up to 0.125 s and fall at 2 K/s thereafter. The wall is 0.5 K warmer, driving a constant 1 W/m² into the material. Two faces have areas 0.25 and 0.75 m² and independent film fluxes 0.5 and -0.75 W/m². With areal capacity 3 J/(m² K), the independent heater flux is 3*dT/dt+1-film_flux. Integrate each physical channel on [0,0.25] and [0.25,0.5] s under CN and Rannacher and compare the temperature trajectory. A separate north-wall mixed-face test checks static heating and cooling with zero film coefficient.
